scores.label: A
scores.note: 1, 2, 4, 5 drop 'about', so the estimate becomes exact; 2 also has a dangling modifier; 5 'a large number of sea life' is ungrammatical; 3 'their loss' is ambiguous

scores.label: B
scores.note: 3 says the reefs would suffer, not sea life, which changes the meaning; 5 is awkward ('being a home') and drops 'about'; 4 'devastate' overstates

scores.label: C
scores.note: 1 'one-quarter of every marine creature' is nonsensical and changes species to creatures; 5 'a quarter of every ocean species' is ungrammatical; 3 shifts species to 'ocean life'; 4 'residence' is stiff
